description: A pad voice built by the PadSynth method, with a fader for each of 48 partials and every change smoothed as the wavetable is built again

params.text: Sets how wide each partial is spread in the spectrum, 0.5 to 60; wider partials give the chorused, breathing quality of a pad
Attenuates the voltage at the jack below the BW knob before it is added to that knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Sets how much that width grows towards the higher partials, 0.5 to 4
Attenuates the voltage at the jack below the Scl knob before it is added to that knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Sets the seed the phases of the partials are drawn from, 0 to 1, which changes the sound a little without changing the harmonics
Picks how a random fill draws the partial strengths: Harmonic Min, Even Min, Odd Min, Harmonic Weibull, Even Weibull or Odd Weibull
Fills all 48 faders at random by the chosen method
Sets the fundamental frequency the wavetable is built at, 16Hz to 2048Hz as a power of two; raising it helps when only high notes are played
Sets the strength of that partial, 0 to 1

inputs.text: The pitch the wavetable is read at, 1V per octave, one channel per voice
Modulates the bandwidth, three steps per volt scaled by the Bandwidth CV knob
Modulates that growth, a fifth per volt scaled by the Bandwidth Scale CV knob
Sets the strengths of the second to the seventeenth partials, one channel per partial, 0-10V for each, and moves those faders while it is patched
Sets the strengths of the eighteenth to the thirty-third partials, one channel per partial, and moves those faders while it is patched
Sets the strengths of the thirty-fourth to the forty-ninth partials, one channel per partial, and moves those faders while it is patched
A trigger here fills all 48 faders at random by the chosen method

outputs.text: The left side of the wave
The right side of the wave, which is the same table read half a cycle away, so the two sides differ

notes: every change builds the wavetable again in a background thread, so the knobs and faders can be moved while the sound plays; fast changes cost a good part of another processor
the first partial is fixed at full strength and has no fader; the 48 faders are the partials above it
with Faders placed immediately to the right, hovering over that module and pressing f fetches these 48 strengths into it, which is how a sound is carried across to a smaller Pad module

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 60V.
inputs.2:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 4V.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the faders; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.4:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the faders; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.5:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the faders; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.6: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
